dossier.scp_unleashed.207.title: Cola Bottles
dossier.scp_unleashed.207.caption: The SCP-207 crate at intake. It was full again the next morning.

page.title: Special Containment Procedures:
text: The SCP-207 crate is kept on a dry shelf in a staffed storage room. Bottles may be issued on request, never more than one per person per shift, and unopened bottles are returned to the shelf.

Blue-capped instances (SCP-207-1) are kept in a separate locked storage container and are never issued alongside standard SCP-207. Personnel showing signs of exposure are relieved of duty and kept away from SCP-207 until they recover.

page.title: Description:
text: SCP-207 is a red-painted wooden crate of glass cola bottles of a classic contoured design, each with a red crown cap and a plain red and white label. However many bottles are taken, the crate is full again by the next morning, but it holds only so many in a day, however many hands reach into it.

The cola tastes ordinary. Drinkers become quicker on their feet, and every further bottle adds to the effect. The effect carries a toll that builds slowly: the drinker's sight softens and loses its colour, and heavy drinkers have been lost to it. A long period without SCP-207 lets the toll fade.
Roughly one bottle in ten carries a blue cap and violet cola. These are designated SCP-207-1. Drinking one alone leaves the subject briefly light on their feet.

page.title: Addendum 207-1: Test Log
text: Test 207-02: D-9341 drank one bottle and finished the obstacle course in record time. He asked for another.
Test 207-05: D-9341 was given four bottles over an hour. He reported that the room had gone grey and the walls kept doubling. Testing was halted; he recovered after a long rest.
Incident 207-1-A: a researcher kept a blue-capped bottle and an ordinary one in the same lunch bag. Test Chamber 2 had to be rebuilt. %rThe two are not to share a shelf again.%r

page.title: Addendum 207-2: Provenance
page.text: SCP-207 has no recovery record. The crate was handed to a reader of this file by the individual in Foundation dress described in the files of other objects. See field notes.

item.scp_unleashed.scp207_bottle.tooltip: A cold glass bottle of cola with a red crown cap. It fizzes the moment the cap comes off.
item.scp_unleashed.scp207_bottle.drink: Hold use to drink; it puts a spring in your step
item.scp_unleashed.scp207_bottle.place: Sneak and use on a surface to set it down; up to four share a spot
item.scp_unleashed.scp207_bottle.warning: Its pull builds with every bottle, and it is slow to let go
item.scp_unleashed.scp207_1_bottle.toolt: The same make of bottle, but the cola inside is violet and the crown cap is blue.
item.scp_unleashed.scp207_1_bottle.drink: Hold use to drink; you feel oddly light for a while
item.scp_unleashed.scp207_1_bottle.warni: Site orders keep these on their own shelf

block.scp_unleashed.scp207_crate.take: Use the crate to take a bottle
block.scp_unleashed.scp207_crate.daily: It only holds so many bottles a day, shared by everyone

jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp207_bottle.1: SCP-207 is a classic contoured glass bottle of dark cola with a red crown cap and a plain red and white label. Drinking one quickens your step, and every further bottle quickens it more.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp207_bottle.2: The quickness has a price that builds slowly, bottle by bottle. Those who keep drinking report their sight going soft and the colours draining away. Staying away from it for a long while is the only known remedy.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp207_bottle.3: Sneak and use a bottle on a surface to set it down. Up to %s bottles share one spot; use another bottle on them to add one, and break them or use them with an empty hand to take one back. A storage container holds four bottles and a tall one eight; sneak and use the open door with an empty hand to take back the last one put in.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp207_1_bottle.1: SCP-207-1 is a rare bottle from the same crate. The cola inside is violet and the crown cap is blue. Drinking it leaves you briefly light on your feet.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp207_1_bottle.2: Site staff shelve SCP-207-1 apart from ordinary SCP-207 and never issue both to the same person. The reason is on file in the dossier.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp207_crate.1: A red cola crate that holds SCP-207. Use it to take a bottle. Now and then a blue-capped bottle comes out instead.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp207_crate.2: It holds %s bottles a day, shared by everyone who uses it, and it refills at dawn.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp207_crate.3: It cannot be crafted. Recover the SCP-207 dossier from an Archive Terminal and break its seal; a stranger in Foundation dress delivers the crate in person.

message.scp_unleashed.scp207.omen.1: The colours around you look washed out.
message.scp_unleashed.scp207.omen.2: Everything feels far away and grey.
